dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Fine art and good food. Ah, what a wonderful life...

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: It is a pleasure to have met you on this fine day, dear guest. My name is Vaneigem, and I am the owner of this establishment.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: If you have any comments or suggestions regarding the menu or performances, please do speak your mind. I will do my best to provide you with more comprehensive services.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: As you know, we often invite artists to perform here at our restaurant. The most popular of these are the magical performers Mr. Lyney and Ms. Lynette.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: "Art is the key ingredient in fine dining" — this is something that I believe in most strongly, and I hope that the cultural atmosphere here shall spread far and wide.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Farewell, dear guest. I hope that Hotel Debord shall leave you with wondrous memories.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for your appreciation, dear guest. If you don't mind, please accept this sweet treat as a personal thank-you gift.
